title: ProposalSubmit
description: RFC 0249 §B. The `submitProposal` body: a client-authored draft, accepted only when `agents.proposals.clientDrafts` is `true`. The host MUST refuse a `kind` outside `artifactKinds` with `400 validation_error` (`details.field: kind`), MUST set `provenance.sourceRunIds: []`, and MUST hold the draft to every RFC 0096 rule, inertness first.

kind.description: The artifact kind; MUST be one the host advertises in `artifactKinds`.

artifact.description: The proposed artifact, shaped by `kind`'s own schema. Inert until applied; validated against that schema at apply (`422` on mismatch).
